On the right, the blonde woman in a yellow pineapple-print top (R1) stands in profile facing left, smiling warmly. She holds the toddler girl in a blue swimsuit (R2) aloft on the left. The toddler girl (R2) is held high in the air by the blonde woman (R1) and looks down at her. The bright, direct sunlight illuminates the scene, highlighting the vibrant blue of the water and sky.
